DEN_Refugee
Rikka is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She is one of the guards on the gate's ramparts, and is Doni's guardian.
“
How do you drow do that - find pleasure in killing? I got a goblin myself, yesterday. Shot her through the throat.
„
— Rikka, on spilling blood

Involvement

Act One

Rikka is one of the guards atop the entrance to the Emerald Grove. After the initial goblin attack on the Grove, Rikka moves near  Kanon's corpse after  Arka leaves. She and  Kaldani pray to Selûne for Kanon, where Rikka reveals that Kanon must have been just as homesick as she was. If a party member interacts with Rikka after the prayer, she informs them she felt horrified after shooting a goblin through the throat, bearing witness to the goblin suffering a slow arduous death instead of the painless one she expected.

If Rikka survives the goblin assault, she shares instructions with everyone on how to stay safe during the trip to Baldur's Gate.

If the party travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving  Kagha's ritual the Rite of Thorns, the tieflings are expelled from the Emerald Grove and Rikka's corpse is among the pile of refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village.

Finding Doni

If  Minthara and her raiding party are primed to assault the Emerald Grove, Rikka searches The Hollow for  Doni, who mysteriously disappeared before she could bring him to the Tiefling Hideout. This starts ⁠Find Doni. Doni is at the door to the Inner Sanctum. Telling him to find safety at the hideout results in Rikka thanking the party before joining the rest of the defending tieflings. Rikka converses with him as though it is a back-and-forth, despite him being nonverbal.[1]

Idle banter

Kaldani and Rikka mourn Kannon:

  • Rikka
    Why does this keep happening? He was joking about Okta's soup just a moment ago...
  • Kaldani
    Come on, Rikka.
  • Rikka
    And now what? We dig a hole and be done with him?
  • Kaldani
    We... we could say a prayer. We should have time for that.
  • Rikka
    Yeah... yeah, that would be good.
  • Rikka
    O Selûne, Our Lady of Silver. Please, may he rest by Your side.
  • Rikka
    He... he never hurt anyone. He always knew what to say... when I was homesick. He never let it show, but he was homesick, too. He didn't deserve this.

If the Grove prepare for a goblin raid during Act One, Lakrissa and Rikka visit Dammon for supplies:

  • Rikka
    I do need some armour, you know.
  • Lakrissa
    Me too.
  • Dammon
    Can't outfit all of you at once.
  • Dammon
    Anything else?
  • Lakrissa
    Yes. A stiff drink.
  • Rikka
    Make that two.
  • Rikka
    I'm worried. I don't think we're ready.
  • Lakrissa
    Ready as we'll ever be.
  • Dammon
    Lakrissa's right. Can only do what we can.
